ThingDef.label: ship cat
ThingDef.description: A cat bred aboard ships for generations. Hunts vermin, comforts the crew and never minds zero gravity.

ThingDef.label: hold rat
ThingDef.description: A ship pest that gnaws through stores and wiring.

ThingDef.label: void whale
ThingDef.description: A peaceful giant of deep space. Seeing one is said to bring luck.

ThingDef.label: void swarmer
ThingDef.description: A metal-eating swarm creature from asteroid belts. Feeds on hulls.

ThingDef.label: nebula jelly
ThingDef.description: A drifting jelly that filters rare gases from nebulae.

ThingDef.label: asteroid worm
ThingDef.description: A burrowing worm that tunnels through asteroids and attacks miners.

ThingDef.label: solar lizard
ThingDef.description: A lizard whose mirror-like scales reflect starlight. Its hide resists heat.

ThingDef.label: trail hound
ThingDef.description: A frontier dog with a nose for ore and water.

ThingDef.label: messenger bird
ThingDef.description: A clever bird used on medieval worlds to carry letters and gifts.

ThingDef.label: war beast
ThingDef.description: A huge, armored beast ridden into battle on tribal worlds.

ThingDef.label: star thrumbo
ThingDef.description: A thrumbo variant that lives on airless moons. Its horn shimmers like a nebula.

ThingDef.label: precursor guardian
ThingDef.description: An ancient biological guardian found in precursor ruins.
